name: Taiyou no Futago Mahou Shoujo Rin to Mayura ~Senshi no Shikyuu wa Oeki de Mitasare Ma o Haramu~
original_name: 胎孕の双子魔法少女リンとマユラ ～戦士の子宮は汚液で満たされ魔を孕む～
source:
The earth opened and from its depths came the VIVO, giant world-enders immune to humanity's weapons.

Unable to fight, the people of Tokyo built a massive barricade hoping to keep the giants at bay.

But it only delayed the inevitable. The barricade was breached; all humans were r*ped or slaughtered.

[From DLsite English]
translation:
大地裂开，从地底深处涌出VIVO，这是对人类武器免疫的巨型世界终结者。

由于无法战斗，东京人民建造了巨大的路障，希望将巨人拒之门外。

但这只是推迟了不可避免的事情。路障被突破；所有人类都被强奸或屠杀。

[来自DLsite英文]
